newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Spill sends oil into Russia's Volga river.
newsitem.headline: Spill sends oil into Russia's Volga river.

text.p: About 400 tonnes of oil spilled into the Volga river on Sunday after a pipeline ruptured near the town of Saratov, south of Moscow, Itar-Tass news agency said.
It said a total of 1,200 tonnes of oil leaked out of the pipeline after it burst. Most of it flooded into a ravine near the site of the landing of the first cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin in 1961.
A rescue force of about 40 people equipped with lorries, two excavaors and a bulldozer was trying to recover the oil, it said.
Most of Russia's oil pipelines are ageing and in need of repair.
